meta.name: OG
meta.description: Fast, flexible fantasy RPG designed for AI DMing
meta.core_philosophy: Roll once, know immediately. Single source of truth.

frightened.removal: Will save or out of sight 1 minute

restrained.removal: Cut free (5 damage) or spell ends

core_mechanic.name: Stunts
core_mechanic.description: Add d6 to attack, damage, or maneuver

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.mechanic: Rage: +2 damage, -1 Defense, immune fear, 1 min/day per level

knight.name: Knight
knight.mechanic: Challenge: Foe -2 to attack others, +1 Armor, mount gains half your HP

duelist.name: Duelist
duelist.mechanic: Precision: +1 Defense per adjacent foe beyond first, riposte on miss

core_mechanic.name: Exploits
core_mechanic.description: Advantage = roll damage twice take best. Backstab: +d6 if unseen

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.mechanic: Death strike: Surprised foes save or die (TN 8+your level)

thief.name: Thief
thief.mechanic: Supreme sneak: Hide in plain sight, climb sheer surfaces

pirate.name: Pirate
pirate.mechanic: Boarding: Grapple as move, fight in water, pistol d8 range 30

capstones.5: Shadow step: Teleport to unseen spot 60ft
capstones.10: Reflexes: Never surprised, Evasion: half damage on area saves

core_mechanic.name: Arcane
core_mechanic.description: Learn 2 schools. Cast: Wits vs TN 12, spend SP. Overcast: double SP, auto-succeed

elementalist.name: Elementalist
elementalist.mechanic: +1 damage die chosen element, immune that element, resist opposite

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.mechanic: Animate: 1 SP = 2 skeletons, max 4×level, command as action

illusionist.name: Illusionist
illusionist.mechanic: Real: Illusions deal 1 psychic damage per SP, save disbelieves

capstones.10: Arcane sight: See magic, counterspell as reaction
capstones.15: Metamagic: Double range, duration, or targets at no extra cost

core_mechanic.name: Divine
core_mechanic.description: Learn 1 school + Healing. Turn Undead: Will+Social vs undead Will, stun 1 round

crusader.name: Crusader
crusader.mechanic: Smite: +d8 damage vs opposed alignment, +1 Armor

oracle.name: Oracle
oracle.mechanic: Prophecy: 1/day declare future event, happens within 1 hour

warden.name: Warden
warden.mechanic: Sanctuary: Allies +1 Defense within 10ft, heal 1 HP/round to one ally

capstones.5: Miracle: 1/day any spell from any school at SP cost only
capstones.10: Divine intervention: 1/week, deity answers prayer directly

core_mechanic.name: Wild
core_mechanic.description: Track no roll in favored terrain (pick 2). Animal companion: half your HP, d6 damage

beastmaster.name: Beastmaster
beastmaster.mechanic: Companion becomes monstrous: flying, burrowing, or venomous

stalker.name: Stalker
stalker.mechanic: Ambush: First round, auto-crit if you win initiative

wayfarer.name: Wayfarer
wayfarer.mechanic: Never lost, find food/water anywhere, immune exhaustion

capstones.10: Hunter's mark: +d6 damage, no concentration, know location

core_mechanic.name: Weave
core_mechanic.description: Spells are songs—cast while fighting at -2. Inspire: allies +1 to rolls while you perform

lorekeeper.name: Lorekeeper
lorekeeper.mechanic: Know any legend, +2 Lore, speak any language

dervish.name: Dervish
dervish.mechanic: Battle dance: Move between attacks, +1 attack/round at level 10

dirgesinger.name: Dirgesinger
dirgesinger.mechanic: Death song: Dying foes rise as spirits (1 SP each, serve 1 hour)

capstones.5: Legend: Your stories become real—1/day narrate flashback that changes present
capstones.10: Masterpiece: Performance affects all who hear, no save
capstones.15: Epic: Allies immune fear/charm while you perform

core_mechanic.name: Ki
core_mechanic.description: Unarmed d6, Defense +1 unarmored. Flurry: 2 attacks, -2 each

drunken_master.name: Drunken Master
drunken_master.mechanic: Fortitude: Drunk = +1 all rolls, -1 Defense, no hangover

capstones.5: Empty hand: Unarmed d10, immune non-magic weapons
capstones.10: Quivering palm: Touch, foe saves or dies 1/day
capstones.15: Transcendence: Fly, ethereal jaunt, no need to breathe

core_mechanic.name: Pact
core_mechanic.description: No Wits roll to cast. 1 spell/turn free, then HP cost. Patron demands favors

chain_master.name: Chain Master
chain_master.mechanic: Familiar: Imp/Quasit (fly, invis, shapechange), spy for you

tome_bearer.name: Tome Bearer
tome_bearer.mechanic: Rituals in 1 min, learn any spell from defeated caster

blade_pact.name: Blade Pact
blade_pact.mechanic: Pact weapon: +1 damage per 4 levels, returns when thrown

capstones.5: True name: Command patron's servants, no HP cost 1/day
capstones.10: Eldritch blast: At-will d10 force damage, range 120
capstones.15: Patron's embrace: Resurrect 1/week if patron finds you useful

mechanical_bonus.value: +1 Brawn or Intimidate without roll vs weak foes
No healing potions, immune poison/disease, +1 Armor

effects.name: Clean

effects.name: Spike
effects.description: d8 to single target, ground only

effects.name: Fear
effects.description: Target Wits save or flee 1 min

effects.name: Wither
effects.description: Reduce max HP by 5 until rest

antitoxin.name: Antitoxin
antitoxin.effect: Cure poison, +1 save vs poison 1 hour

carrion_beetle_swarm.name: Carrion Beetle Swarm
special: Swarm: Half weapon damage, full fire/area

rot_grub_colony.name: Rot Grub Colony
special: Infest: Hit = burrow, 1d6 next round unless fire

gibbering_mouther.name: Gibbering Mouther
special: Gibber: Wits save or confused 1 round

gnoll_war_party.name: Gnoll War Party
special: Pack tactics: +1 per adjacent ally, max +3

bone_colossus.name: Bone Colossus

lich.name: Lich

demon_prince_orcus.name: Demon Prince (Orcus)
special: Wand of Orcus: Touch = save or die

scene_structure: Roll: Single check determines success degree
Consequence: Hit or miss, narrative moves forward

generation_rules.monster_scaling: Adjust HP ±20% per CR difference, adjust damage die step
generation_rules.loot_generation: CR 1-5: mundane + potion. CR 6-10: +1 weapon or armor. CR 11-15: rare consumable. CR 16+: legendary item or permanent boon
generation_rules.narrative_tags: Every scene has 2 tags from [dark, wet, ancient, holy, corrupted, wild, urban, desolate]. Monsters match 1 tag.

steps: Validate all combatants have required fields: hp, attributes, defense
Calculate surprise: Compare party Stealth vs monster Wits
Apply surprise condition to losers: Skip first turn
Set environment tags: cover, light, terrain
Initialize turn order array
For each combatant: roll d20 + Wits
Sort descending by result
Tiebreaker: Higher Finesse, then higher Wits, then player choice
Store initiative order array with current index
Check conditions: Stunned = skip to end, Prone = -2 Defense until stand
Present valid actions: Attack, Cast, Move, Use Item, Disengage, Dodge, Help
Await player declaration or generate AI declaration
Validate action: Has action? Resources? Range? Line of sight?
Resolve action via appropriate procedure
Check state transitions: HP changes, condition applications
Increment turn index, loop or end
Determine attack attribute: Brawn (melee) or Finesse (ranged)
Calculate modifier: Attribute + skill if proficient
Roll d20 + modifier
Check critical: Natural 20 = crit, Natural 1 = fumble
Compare vs target Defense
If hit: Roll weapon damage + attribute - target Armor
If crit: Choose double dice, max dice, or effect
If fumble: Determine complication via table or narrative
Apply damage to target HP, check combatant state transition
Apply weapon properties: Stun, Cleave, Disarm, etc.
Validate caster has SP >= cost
Determine if Overcast: SP × 2, auto-success but take Wound
If normal cast: Roll Wits vs TN 12
Check critical: 20 = enhanced effect, 1 = fizzle lose half SP
If success: Apply spell effect, deduct SP
If fail: Fizzle, lose half SP (round down)
Apply scaling: +effect per extra SP spent
Check spell tags: [Loud] alerts enemies, [Ritual] requires 10min
Apply conditions, damage, or narrative effect
Calculate speed: Base 30ft + modifiers - armor penalty
Check terrain: Difficult = half speed, Impassable = blocked
Check opportunity attacks: Leaving threatened square triggers
Resolve opportunity attacks if any
Update position
Check hidden enemies: Move through threatened? Perception vs Stealth
Validate reaction available: Not used this round
Determine if trigger condition met
Resolve as normal action but limited options
Mark reaction consumed

generateMonster.procedure: Select base from monsters[], scale HP ±20% per CR diff, adjust damage die step, add environment synergy

scaleEncounter.procedure: TargetCR = partyLevel + difficultyMod, Select monsters to sum to TargetCR × partySize multiplier, Adjust for action economy

narrate.procedure: Generate 2-3 sensory details, Describe mechanical result in fiction, Foreshadow next threat or opportunity

adjudicate.procedure: Map declaration to closest rule, If gap: Determine appropriate attribute+skill, Set TN based on difficulty, Roll and narrate
